title: Brazilian Financial Data MCP Servers
lead: Open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that give AI assistants direct, structured access to official Brazilian financial, corporate, and macroeconomic open data — with local caching and zero API keys required.
what_is_mcp: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that lets AI assistants (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, Antigravity, and other MCP-compatible clients) call external tools safely. Instead of manually downloading CSV archives or guessing outdated numbers, your assistant can query official CVM, Central Bank (BCB), and Tesouro Direto data directly.

capabilities: Annual (DFP) and quarterly (ITR) financial statements of Brazilian public companies
Corporate reference filings (FRE), governance, and corporate events
Brazilian investment funds (fundos de investimento) data and registration
Insider trading reports and CVM public open-data archives (dados.cvm.gov.br)
example_prompts: Pull Petrobras's (PETR4) annual income statement and balance sheet from CVM DFP for the last 5 years and compute ROE and net margin.
List recent insider trading transactions reported to CVM for Vale over the past 6 months.
Compare revenue growth and leverage across the three largest Brazilian banks using the latest DFP filings.

capabilities: Curated dictionary and search across BCB-SGS macroeconomic and financial series (Selic, IPCA, CDI, PTAX, GDP, credit)
Time-series retrieval and summary statistics directly from the official Central Bank API
Local Parquet caching with DuckDB SQL querying for fast multi-series analysis
example_prompts: Fetch monthly IPCA inflation and the Selic target rate from BCB-SGS since 2015 and calculate the real interest rate.
Search the BCB-SGS catalog for Brazilian USD/BRL exchange rate (PTAX) series and summarize annual averages since 2020.
Query the local cache with SQL to compare annual cumulative IPCA against CDI over the last 10 years.

capabilities: Historical daily prices and yields for Brazilian sovereign bonds (Tesouro Direto)
Current Tesouro Direto purchase and redemption rates across available maturities
Per-maturity yield statistics and the ANBIMA sovereign yield curve
example_prompts: Show current Tesouro IPCA+ (NTN-B) real yields across all available maturities and highlight the longest duration bond.
Fetch historical yields for Tesouro Prefixado 2029 and plot how spreads evolved over the last 12 months.
Retrieve the latest ANBIMA yield curve and summarize the term structure slope between 2-year and 10-year rates.

cross_server_prompts: Combine BCB-SGS (IPCA & Selic), Tesouro Direto (NTN-B real yields), and CVM DFP filings for WEG to build a Brazilian macro-to-fundamentals brief.
Compare the current real yield on 10-year Tesouro IPCA+ bonds against the trailing 12-month IPCA from BCB and the dividend/earnings yield of top B3 utilities.

clients.name: Claude Desktop
clients.notes: Requires uv (for uvx). Add the block below to your config file and restart Claude Desktop.

clients.name: Cursor
clients.notes: Create or edit mcp.json in your workspace or home directory, then reload MCP servers in Cursor Settings.

clients.name: Claude Code (CLI)
clients.notes: Register all three servers directly from the command line using uvx (no global Python environment pollution).
clients.snippet:
claude mcp add bcb -- uvx bcb-mcp
claude mcp add cvm -- uvx cvm-mcp
claude mcp add tesourodireto -- uvx tesourodireto-mcp

clients.name: Windsurf / Antigravity / Generic MCP Client
clients.notes: Any client supporting the standard stdio MCP transport can launch the servers via uvx or pipx.

ai_tools.label: ML / NLP Package
ai_tools.note: Detect AI-generated text in financial documents (companion library to the 2026 Finance Research Letters study on AI in 10-K filings).
